tables.comment: 排班例外；一行代表一条排班例外记录

checks.name: CK_SC_SCHED_EXCEP_SCHED_EXCE_1
checks.expression:
(("sd_except_type" = 'CLOSED')
    AND ("qty_minute_start" IS NULL)
    AND ("qty_minute_end" IS NULL)
    AND ("qty_capcty" IS NULL)
    AND ("qty_slot_minutes" IS NULL))
    OR (("sd_except_type" = 'OVERRIDE')
    AND ("qty_minute_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)
    AND ("qty_minute_end" BETWEEN 1 AND 1439)
    AND ("qty_capcty" BETWEEN 1 AND 500)
    AND ("qty_minute_end" > "qty_minute_start")
    AND (("qty_slot_minutes" IS NULL)
    OR ("qty_slot_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 120)))

tables.catalogComment: 排班例外；一行代表一条排班例外记录
